name: 05_exec_feedback
description: A marshmallow issue (SWE-bench Lite dev) with 'Run existing tests' on: the repository's existing tests run in a Docker sandbox at the base commit and again with the applied edit; regressions would go back to the Reviewer.
expect: The trace shows the test check after the edit (passed, or regressions followed by a Reviewer diagnosis and a Coder retry) and ends awaiting confirmation. Needs Docker and the task's evaluation image; without them the trace says test execution is unavailable.
